name: SVC_WO_AREA_CONFIGS
description: Table used to store the work zone configuration that is used for retrieving the work order area from Oracle Field Service Cloud. CONFIG_ID is the primary key in this table.

columns.name: CONFIG_ID
columns.description: An autogenerated unique number and primary key for the SVC_WO_AREA_CONFIGS table.

columns.name: CONNECTION_CD
columns.description: The foreign key referencing the CONNECTION_CD in the SVC_WO_CONNECTIONS table.

columns.name: CONFIG_NUMBER
columns.description: An autogenerated unique number with customizable format.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order area configuration to identify if a specific configuration is enabled.

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_TO_RETURN
columns.description: Property used for the work order configuration to identify the number of records to return from Oracle Field Service Cloud that match the work zone definition and fitness formulas.

columns.name: FITNESS_FORMULA_WOZONE
columns.description: Property used for the work order area configuration to identify the work zone fitness formula for Oracle Field Service Cloud.

columns.name: FITNESS_FORMULA_SKILL
columns.description: Property used for the work order area configuration to identify the work skill fitness formula for Oracle Field Service Cloud.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
